title: Traversable Wormholes
description: Black and white holes joined at the throat, propped open with negative mass.

puzzle.goal: A static, spherically symmetric throat of radius r0 joins two regions of space. Its shape is set by a function b(r) = r0²/r, and the field equations relate the energy density at radius r to the radial derivative of b. Write the mass density needed.
puzzle.name: Morris–Thorne energy density (Ellis wormhole)
puzzle.ask: The derivative is −r0²/r²; at the throat (r = r0), in units G = c = 1, ρ = −1/(8πr0²). Find it for the throat radius below.
puzzle.method: Take the time-time component of the field equations for the throat metric ds² = −c²dt² + dr²/(1 − b/r) + r²dΩ².
